info.description:
FinTasks project management API.

Authentication uses HttpOnly cookies (`access_token`, `refresh_token`) set by register/login. State-changing requests that carry cookies must also send the `X-CSRF-Token` header (the value of the `csrf_token` cookie). Authorization is policy-based (PBAC): see docs/authorization-design.md.
info.title: FinTasks API
